This error was likely due to a misinterpretation of search results or reliance on an unreliable source. This mistake led to confusion and unnecessary efforts to resolve the conflict, as the correct birthplace (Rosario, Argentina) was consistently listed in credible sources like Wikipedia and IMDb.
